race.title: Golwg Gwendraeth Novices' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Anthony Honeyball has enjoyed plenty of recent success and his CORNER FORWARD is fancied to build on the promise of his handicap debut here back in the spring with this step up to 2½m sure to be in his favour. Heading up the dangers is Built By Rossies , who hasn't been seen for a while but the switch to the powerful Olly Murphy yard catches the eye making just her second handicap start. Finjimk may well emerge as best of the rest. CORNER FORWARD (IRE) BUILT BY ROSSIES (IRE) FINJIMK (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Bound For Glory (3/1), Built By Rossies (4/1), Billy Butcher (11/2), Finjimk (11/2), Corner Forward (6/1), Out Of Focus (8/1), Nancefordshore (12/1), Jet Joe (14/1), Nube De Trueno (25/1)
